# Ellipses

> **这页管什么**：一般不用；UI 标签里的省略号要去掉。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/ellipses> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## General

**In general, don't use ellipses.** They show that non-essential text has been left out.

## Hesitation

Don't use ellipses to show hesitation or dramatic pause.

## UI references

Skip ellipses shown in UI text when describing that UI, unless leaving them out would confuse readers. A button labeled "Save …" is documented as "click **Save**".

## In prose

Avoid them in your own writing — instead omit unnecessary information and include all necessary information.

Ellipses are permitted in quoted material to show where text was cut, but not at the start or end of the quotation. If the omitted portion spans one or more full sentence breaks, use **four** dots (the extra one is the closing period).

## Formatting

Build ellipses from **three periods in a row**, not the single ellipsis character. Keep the three dots together. Add a space before and after, except skip the space after if punctuation immediately follows.
